{{Short description|Italian mathematician (1947–2020)}}
[[File:Alberto Collino.png|thumb]]
'''Alberto Collino''' (1947 – 12 September 2020) was an Italian [[mathematician]] best known for his contributions in the field of [[algebraic geometry]].<ref name=lastampa>{{cite news|title=È morto Alberto Collino, di Verzuolo: fu professore di Matematica dell’Università di Torino. Aveva 73 anni|newspaper=La Stampa|date=12 September 2020}}</ref>

Collino was born in [[Verzuolo]],<ref name=lastampa/> earned a laurea in mathematics in 1970 from the [[University of Turin]], and completed a [[Ph.D.]] in 1974 at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]].<ref name=cv>{{cite web|url=http://www.campusnet.unito.it/docenti/att/acollino.cv.pdf|title=Curriculum vitae|accessdate=2020-09-13}}</ref> His dissertation, ''The Rational Equivalence Ring of Symmetric Products of Curves'', was supervised by [[Arthur Mattuck]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy |id=62628}}</ref> He spent his professional career at the University of Turin, beginning as an assistant in 1970 and becoming a full professor in 1984.<ref name=cv/>

He died in [[Milan]].<ref name=lastampa/>

In 2025, a two-volume collection of papers written in memory of Alberto Collino was published by [[Birkhäuser]] in the series "Progress in Mathematics".<ref>{{cite web  |editor-last1 = Albano |editor-first1 = Alberto |editor-last2 = Aluffi |editor-first2 = Paolo |editor-last3 = Bolognesi |editor-first3 = Michele |editor-last4=Casagrande |editor-first4=Cinzia |editor-last5=Colombo |editor-first5=Elisabetta |editor-last6=Conte |editor-first6=Alberto |editor-last7=Grassi |editor-first7=Antonella |editor-last8=Pedrini |editor-first8=Claudio |editor-last9=Pirola |editor-first9=Gian Pietro |editor-last10=Verra |editor-first10=Alessandro |title=Perspectives on Four Decades of Algebraic Geometry, Volume 1 |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-031-66230-0 |website=Springer Nature |access-date=12 November 2025 |language=en |date=2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web  |editor-last1 = Albano |editor-first1 = Alberto |editor-last2 = Aluffi |editor-first2 = Paolo |editor-last3 = Bolognesi |editor-first3 = Michele |editor-last4=Casagrande |editor-first4=Cinzia |editor-last5=Colombo |editor-first5=Elisabetta |editor-last6=Conte |editor-first6=Alberto |editor-last7=Grassi |editor-first7=Antonella |editor-last8=Pedrini |editor-first8=Claudio |editor-last9=Pirola |editor-first9=Gian Pietro |editor-last10=Verra |editor-first10=Alessandro |title=Perspectives on Four Decades of Algebraic Geometry, Volume 2 
|url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-031-66234-8 |website=Springer Nature |access-date=12 November 2025 |language=en |date=2025}}</ref>
